ios.desc:
Forget less. Study smarter. Memor More uses spaced repetition, the science-backed method that brings each card back right before you'd forget it, so every minute of review actually sticks.
Built for students, language learners, medical candidates and anyone who needs to keep what they learn, not just pass tomorrow's test.

Why it works
— An adaptive review schedule learns what you struggle with and brings it back at the right time, not randomly and not on a fixed loop
— Make cards in seconds with rich formatting, images and text-to-speech audio
— Four card types: Basic, Cloze (blank out words in a sentence), Image Occlusion (hide the labels on a diagram or textbook page) and Drawing (sketch a diagram with your finger or Apple Pencil, then hide its labels)
— AI builds complete decks on any topic at the depth you choose, from a broad overview to fine detail
— Practice turns a deck into exercise sets, so you test yourself in new ways instead of rereading
— Speed Round: answer as many cards as you can in 60 seconds, build combos and chase a new best
— Moving from Anki? Import your decks, including images, cloze and image occlusion notes
— Start right away with ready-made decks for languages, science, history, driving theory and more
— Shared decks let teachers send card sets to a whole class and update them once for everyone
— Study on iPhone, iPad and Mac: the Mac app syncs with your other devices through iCloud, and Home Screen widgets let you review without opening the app

Premium — optional upgrade
— More AI-generated decks and practice sets, tailored to your topic, level and depth
— Advanced learning stats that show exactly where you're gaining and where you're slipping
— Unlimited group sharing for classrooms, study teams and cohorts

Your cards live on your device and in iCloud. No account is needed for the core app, and we never sell your data.
Ready to remember more? Download Memor More and start your first deck in under a minute.
